items.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: And then a week after that at Sweet Basil’s with Benny Waters.

ctx.x: And you’re off to where after this?
Back to New York, working a week in a club with Ken Peplowski and Michael Moore. And then a week after that at Sweet Basil’s with Benny Waters.
Oh you’re going to do the Benny Waters.
